zh.title: 阿根廷退役超级艾滕达戰機 結束40年服役
zh.summary: 阿根廷退役超级艾滕達戰機 結束40年服役 歸還法國
body: 阿根廷政府宣布，將於2026年底永久退役其Super Étendard戰機，結束超過四十年的服役歷史。
這批飛機於1982年 Falklands 戰爭時因使用AM39 Exocet飛彈擊沉英國HMS Sheffield和Atlantic Conveyor而聞名。
阿根廷 navy 於2023年放棄恢復五架自法國購入的Super Étendard Modernisé (SEM)的計畫，因為英國出口限制導致無法取得Martin-Baker彈射座椅的關鍵零件。
阿根廷 navy 表示，這批飛機自2019年交付以來從未進入實彈服役。
阿根廷 navy 並表示，將於2027年退役其單架Eurocopter AS555 Fennec 2直升機，並於2031年退役SH-3 Sea Kings。

en.title: Argentina to Retire Super Étendard Fighters by End of 2026
en.summary: Argentina retires Super Étendard fighters ending 40 years of service returning jets to France
body: Argentina has announced it will permanently retire its Super Étendard aircraft by the end of 2026, bringing more than four decades of service to a close.
The Super Étendard played a prominent role during the 1982 Falklands War, sinking HMS Sheffield and the logistics vessel Atlantic Conveyor using AM39 Exocet missiles.

The five ex-French Navy Super Étendard Modernisé (SEM) jets delivered to Argentina in 2019 never entered operational service due to UK export restrictions preventing the acquisition of Martin-Baker ejection seat components.
Argentina's Navy abandoned plans to return the SEM aircraft to service in 2023 before announcing their retirement this year.
Argentina also plans to retire its single Eurocopter AS555 Fennec 2 helicopter in 2027 and its SH-3 Sea Kings from 2031.

sources.name: Aerospace Global News — Argentina’s Falklands-era fighter to retire this year News

facts.claim: Argentina will permanently retire its Super Étendard aircraft by the end of 2026.
facts.sourceQuote: Argentina has announced it will permanently retire its Super Étendard aircraft by the end of 2026. This brings more than four decades of service to a close.

facts.claim: The five ex-French Navy Super Étendard Modernisé jets delivered in 2019 never entered operational service due to UK export restrictions on Martin-Baker ejection seat components.
facts.sourceQuote: The issue was the British-built Martin-Baker Mk.6 ejection seats, which required new pyrotechnic cartridges and rocket motors that could not be obtained because of UK export restrictions.

facts.claim: Argentina's Navy abandoned plans to return the SEM aircraft to service in 2023 before announcing their retirement in 2026.
facts.sourceQuote: The Argentine Navy abandoned plans to return the aircraft to service in 2023, before announcing their retirement this year.

facts.claim: Argentina also plans to retire its single Eurocopter AS555 Fennec 2 helicopter in 2027 and its SH-3 Sea Kings from 2031.
facts.sourceQuote: Argentina has formally said it will retire its naval Super Étendards in 2026, as well as its single Eurocopter AS555 Fennec 2 helicopter in 2027, its Beechcraft B-200s after the Beechcraft B-360s arrive in 2027, and its SH-3 Sea Kings from 2031.
